messages.subject: SV: how to use evidence with deal
messages.subject_clean: SV: how to use evidence with deal
messages.body_plain:
Dear Thomas

Inference is not implemented in 'deal' - only the learning part.

For inference, you should use Hugin, but some R-packages are appearing that may help you. See e.g. http://rhugin.r-forge.r-project.org/ and http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/gRain/index.html

Best,
Claus

messages.subject: Re: SV: how to use evidence with deal
messages.subject_clean: SV: how to use evidence with deal
messages.body_plain:
Thanks Claus,

I don't want to use hugin. I'de rather try to use openbugs with rbugs, 
but didn't yet figure out how to utilise Bayesian Networks with winbugs.

Wouldn't inclusion of exact inference in deal (for discrete networks) 
just mean to modify jointdisc(nw, timetrace = FALSE) to jointdisc(nw, 
evidence = NULL, timetrace = FALSE). For me this looks promising, did 
you ever try this step? Which experiences did you get? Has it been too slow?

regards,
Thomas
